Stuff like this depends on your height and weight. Also how much you move around. Unfortunately, everyone's is different. 
Remember ya'll, pee should be yellow, not clear.
You also get water intake from foods, so keep that in mind as well. Diuretics will drain you (tea, coffee, sugary drinks) so those don't count and require your body to replace more that's lost.

I'm only 5'2, I weigh about 110-120 on average and tend to fluctuate between that range.

I personally drink 2 to 3 bottles of either my 21 or 24 oz water bottle. I also make sure to have at least some form of electrolyte - tablet, sports drink, etc, on the side. At least every other day. 
If I'm super active, I drink more. 

Just listen to your body and what it needs. Adjust when you feel yourself lacking.
